list.name: Run succeeded
list.expr: label_replace(label_replace(max by (job_name) (kube_job_status_completion_time{namespace="obsync"}) * 1000 and on (job_name) ((time() - max by (job_name) (kube_job_status_completion_time{namespace="obsync"})) < 1800), "trigger", "manual", "job_name", ".*"), "trigger", "scheduled", "job_name", "obsync-worker-[0-9]+")
list.textFormat: A {{trigger}} worker run finished and published. Its data written and objects changed are in the Run history table. For the file-level list: kubectl -n obsync logs job/{{job_name}} (only while the pod still exists).

list.name: Run failed
list.expr: label_replace(label_replace(max by (job_name) (kube_job_status_start_time{namespace="obsync"}) * 1000 and on (job_name) (max by (job_name) (kube_job_status_failed{namespace="obsync"}) > 0) and on (job_name) ((time() - max by (job_name) (kube_job_status_start_time{namespace="obsync"})) < 3 * 3600), "trigger", "manual", "job_name", ".*"), "trigger", "scheduled", "job_name", "obsync-worker-[0-9]+")
list.textFormat: A pod of this {{trigger}} run exited non-zero (Kubernetes retries up to twice). Exit 3: another run held the store lease. Exit 4: Canvas rejected the token, which only a new token fixes. Logs: kubectl -n obsync logs job/{{job_name}}

list.name: New worker version
list.expr: label_replace(max by (image) (kube_pod_container_info{namespace="obsync", container="worker"}) * 0 + 1 unless on (image) max by (image) (max_over_time(kube_pod_container_info{namespace="obsync", container="worker"}[7d] offset 30m)) and on () (count(max_over_time(kube_pod_container_info{namespace="obsync", container="worker"}[7d] offset 30m)) > 0), "commit", "$1", "image", ".*:([0-9a-f]{7,40})")

description: obsync worker (Canvas -> garage-obsync): run results, how much each run changed, and the health of the store it writes to.

panels.title: Last success
panels.description: Time since the CronJob last completed a run. The schedule is daily at 18:17 Asia/Singapore; ObsyncWorkerStale fires past 26h.

panels.title: Last run
panels.description: Result of the most recent scheduled run. Failed means it has been scheduled since the last success: it failed through its retries or hit the 2h deadline. See the Run history table.

targets.expr: (max(kube_cronjob_status_active{namespace="obsync", cronjob="obsync-worker"}) > 0) * 0 + 2 or (max(kube_cronjob_status_last_schedule_time{namespace="obsync", cronjob="obsync-worker"}) > bool (max(kube_cronjob_status_last_successful_time{namespace="obsync", cronjob="obsync-worker"}) or vector(0)))

panels.title: Next run
panels.description: When the CronJob will next start a Job.

panels.title: Failed runs
panels.description: Runs in the selected time range that ended without succeeding. A run whose pod failed and then succeeded on retry is not counted here; the Run history table shows its retries.

targets.expr: count(max by (job_name) (max_over_time(kube_job_status_failed{namespace="obsync"}[$__range])) > 0 unless on (job_name) max by (job_name) (max_over_time(kube_job_status_succeeded{namespace="obsync"}[$__range])) > 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Schedule
panels.description: Suspended means `suspend: true` is committed in cronjob.yaml. Missing means kube-state-metrics has no CronJob: the Application is not synced or its sealed secret is absent.

panels.title: Garage store
panels.description: Garage's own view of the cluster the worker writes to (garage-obsync). Degraded means a node or partition quorum is missing and writes may fail.

panels.title: Run history
panels.description: One row per worker Job in the selected range (Prometheus keeps 10 days; Kubernetes itself keeps only the last 3 successful Jobs). Data written and objects written/deleted are Garage's counters for the minutes around the run: ~10 objects and a few KB is a run that found nothing new (lease, manifests, run summary); more means new or changed Canvas files. Click Started to zoom to the run, or the commit to see the worker code that ran.

panels.title: Data written to the store
panels.description: Logical bytes the worker uploaded to Garage (block writes divided by the replication factor). Spikes are runs that pulled new or changed Canvas files.

panels.title: Store requests
panels.description: S3 requests Garage served, by operation. Writes and deletes come only from the worker (and `obsync gc -apply`); reads include the Obsidian plugin. HeadObject 404s are normal: the worker checks whether an object exists before writing it.

targets.expr: sum by (api_endpoint, status_code) (increase((api_s3_error_counter{namespace="obsync"} unless api_s3_error_counter{namespace="obsync", api_endpoint="HeadObject", status_code="404"})[$__interval:]))

panels.title: obsync alerts
panels.description: ObsyncWorkerStale, ObsyncWorkerLastRunFailed, ObsyncWorkerMissing and ObsyncWorkerSuspended, firing or pending. Empty is the healthy state.

panels.title: Nodes connected
panels.description: Garage nodes this node can reach, out of those it knows. Taken from the worst-connected pod.

panels.title: Partitions with quorum
panels.description: Partitions where a write quorum is available. Below 100% some objects cannot be written.

panels.title: Resync queue
panels.description: Blocks waiting to be copied between nodes. Rises after a node reboot and should drain back to 0.

panels.title: Resync errors
panels.description: Blocks Garage has repeatedly failed to resync. Non-zero needs a look: `garage block list-errors`.

panels.title: Lowest disk free
panels.description: Free space on the fullest node's data volume.

options.content:
**Schedule.** Daily at **18:17 Asia/Singapore**, `concurrencyPolicy: Forbid`, 2 retries, 2h deadline. A failed run changes nothing the plugin sees: `latest` is only published at the end.

**Annotations** (toggle at the top; click a marker for details):
- **Run succeeded** (green) / **Run failed** (red): one per worker Job.
- **New worker version** (blue): the first run on a new image, with a link to the commit.

**Exactly which files a run changed** is not in Prometheus: the worker keeps no metrics of its own yet. It is in two places:
- The run's log, while its pod still exists (the last 3 successful Jobs, until a node drain deletes them):
```
kubectl -n obsync logs job/<Job> | jq -c 'select(.msg=="latest.published" or .msg=="course.done")'
```
- The durable run summary in the bucket, `runs/<run_id>.json`, and each course's change log:
```
kubectl -n obsync create job --from=cronjob/obsync-worker obsync-log --dry-run=client -o json \
| jq '.spec.template.spec.containers[0].command = ["/usr/local/bin/obsync"]
    | .spec.template.spec.containers[0].args = ["log", "<course-id>"]' \
| kubectl apply -f - && kubectl -n obsync wait --for=condition=complete job/obsync-log \
&& kubectl -n obsync logs job/obsync-log && kubectl -n obsync delete job obsync-log
```

**Exit codes:** 0 ok, 1 failed, 2 configuration, 3 another run holds the store lease, **4 Canvas rejected the token** (NUS tokens expire; reseal a new one, retries will not help).

**Run it now:** `kubectl -n obsync create job --from=cronjob/obsync-worker obsync-manual-$(date +%s)`

Full background: `apps/obsync-worker/README.md`.
